scheme_name: Exhibition Component of the Development Of Handicrafts Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry
Applicant must have a handicraft unit
benefits_summary: Travel allowance for train fare plus daily cash allowances (₹300, ₹200 or ₹150 per crafts person depending on city) and reimbursement of transport expenses for handicraft goods.
